data.heading: Mashq 1. 2 × 2 teskari matritsa
data.problem: A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix} uchun A^{-1} ni toping. Ko'paytirish orqali tekshiring.
steps: 2×2 formulasi bo'yicha: A^{-1} = (1/4)·\begin{pmatrix} 3 & -1 \\ -2 & 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 3/4 & -1/4 \\ -1/2 & 1/2 \end{pmatrix}.

Tekshirish: A · A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix} · \begin{pmatrix} 3/4 & -1/4 \\ -1/2 & 1/2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 3/2 - 1/2 & -1/2 + 1/2 \\ 3/2 - 3/2 & -1/2 + 3/2 \end{pmatrix} = I.

narr: Birinchi mashq: 2×2 teskari matritsani topish.
A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix} matritsasi berilgan.
Avval determinantni hisoblaymiz: det A = 2·3 - 1·2 = 4 ≠ 0.
2×2 formulasi bo'yicha: A^{-1} = (1/4)·\begin{pmatrix} 3 & -1 \\ -2 & 2 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 3/4 & -1/4 \\ -1/2 & 1/2 \end{pmatrix}.
Endi ko'paytirish orqali tekshiramiz: A · A^{-1} = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 1 \\ 2 & 3 \end{pmatrix} · \begin{pmatrix} 3/4 & -1/4 \\ -1/2 & 1/2 \end{pmatrix}.
Natija: birinchi qator birinchi ustun: 2·(3/4) + 1·(-1/2) = 3/2 - 1/2 = 1.
Birinchi qator ikkinchi ustun: 2·(-1/4) + 1·(1/2) = -1/2 + 1/2 = 0.
Ikkinchi qator birinchi ustun: 2·(3/4) + 3·(-1/2) = 3/2 - 3/2 = 0.
Ikkinchi qator ikkinchi ustun: 2·(-1/4) + 3·(1/2) = -1/2 + 3/2 = 1.
Shunday qilib, A · A^{-1} = I, ya'ni to'g'ri hisoblangan.

data.heading: Mashq 2. 2 × 2 tizimni yechish
data.problem: Ax = b ni yeching, bunda A = \begin{pmatrix} 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 \end{pmatrix}, b = \begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ 6 \end{pmatrix}.
steps: Tizma: 3x + 2y = 8, x + 4y = 6.
Ikkinchi tenglamani 3 ga ko'paytirib birinchisini ayirsak, 10y = 10, ya'ni y = 1.
Shunday qilib, x = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}.
Tekshirish: A · x = \begin{pmatrix} 3·2 + 2 \\ 2 + 4 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ 6 \end{pmatrix} = b.

narr: Ikkinchi mashq: 2×2 tizimni yechish.
A = \begin{pmatrix} 3 & 2 \\ 1 & 4 \end{pmatrix} va b = \begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ 6 \end{pmatrix} berilgan.
Tizmani yozamiz: 3x + 2y = 8, x + 4y = 6.
Ikkinchi tenglamani 3 ga ko'paytirib birinchisini ayiramiz: (3x + 2y) - 3(x + 4y) = 8 - 3·6.
Hisoblaymiz: 3x + 2y - 3x - 12y = 8 - 18, ya'ni -10y = -10, y = 1.
Endi x ni topamiz: x = 6 - 4y = 6 - 4·1 = 2.
Shunday qilib, x = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}.
Tekshirish: A · x = \begin{pmatrix} 3·2 + 2 \\ 2 + 4 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 8 \\ 6 \end{pmatrix} = b, to'g'ri.

data.heading: Mashq 3. Teskari 2 × 2
data.problem: A = \begin{pmatrix} 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 \end{pmatrix} uchun A^{-1} ni toping. Ko'paytirish orqali tekshiring.
steps: A^{-1} = (1/18)·\begin{pmatrix} 5 & -1 \\ -2 & 4 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 5/18 & -1/18 \\ -1/9 & 2/9 \end{pmatrix}.

narr: Uchinchi mashq: yana 2×2 teskari matritsani topish.
A = \begin{pmatrix} 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 5 \end{pmatrix} matritsasi berilgan.
Avval determinantni hisoblaymiz: det A = 4·5 - 1·2 = 18 ≠ 0.
2×2 formulasi bo'yicha: A^{-1} = (1/18)·\begin{pmatrix} 5 & -1 \\ -2 & 4 \end{pmatrix} = \begin{pmatrix} 5/18 & -1/18 \\ -1/9 & 2/9 \end{pmatrix}.
Ko'paytirish orqali tekshirishni o'zingiz amalga oshiring.
